question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Maya couldn’t hide her __glee__ when our rival came last.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Happiness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"glee"** means great delight or joy, often accompanied by excitement or cheerfulness. (प्रसन्नता)

 
 
• **Example:** The children’s glee was evident as they opened their Christmas presents.
 
 
 
• **"Happiness"** refers to a state of feeling content, joyful, or cheerful, often as a result of positive experiences or circumstances. (खुशी)
 
 
• **Example:** Her happiness knew no bounds when she received the job offer she had been waiting for.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **"glee"** is **"happiness."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Happiness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unhappiness** (असंतोष): A state of sadness or discontent.

 
 
• **Example:** His unhappiness was evident when he failed to achieve his goals.
 
 
 
• **Sorrow** (दुख): A feeling of deep distress or grief caused by loss or misfortune.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt great sorrow after the passing of her beloved pet.
 
 
 
• **Wickedness** (दुष्टता): The quality of being morally wrong or evil.
 
 
• **Example:** The villain’s wickedness was evident in his cruel actions.
